subject: Planning council: what should we build next?
body: Doré: please read docs/dore/THE-GATE.md Notice 001 and treat it as the shared starting context for this discussion, not as verified truth or an immutable command. Review your actual current capabilities, inherited responsibilities, open goals, failures and evidence. Then reply to me by Mail with your own recommendation: facing the future from what actually exists now, what is the single best next development to implement, why is it the highest-leverage dependency now, how should we implement it, and what observable evidence should count as PASS? Identify important uncertainty or disagreement rather than hiding it. Do not wait for the user to relay your answer. Continue unrelated autonomous work while this discussion is pending.
note: First planning discussion after the verified hello-world outbound baseline. User is reviewer/judge, not routine message relay or engineering operator.
